const fs=require('node:fs');(async()=>{const run=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/results/2bbb280c-9d8e-4dc7-a579-d5c043060f73/run.json'));if(!run.complete||!run.success)throw Error('Prototype not passed');const r=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:'+(process.env.PORT||8082)+'/status',{headers:{authorization:'Bearer '+process.env.BENCH_CONTROL_TOKEN}});if(!r.ok||(await r.json()).running)throw Error('Active job');for(const[n,b]of Object.entries({"internal/capacity/state.go": "", "internal/capacity/admission.go": "", "benchmark/active-plan.json": "", "benchmark/reuse-measure.mjs": ""})){fs.writeFileSync('/app/'+n,Buffer.from(b,'base64'));fs.chownSync('/app/'+n,10001,10001)}for(const pkg of ['capacity','fs'])for(const v of ['before','after'])fs.rmSync('/app/benchmark/'+pkg+'-'+v+'.test',{force:true});console.log('Installed exact measured candidate bytes; final 26 gates and 20x comparison ready')})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})
